services.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) Panel
services.description: Measures red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets. Essential for diagnosing anemia, infection, inflammation, and immune disorders in pets.
services.fastingDetails: No fasting required, normal hydration recommended.

services.name: Comprehensive Urinalysis & Sedimentation
services.description: Evaluates chemical properties, crystals, bacteria, and protein levels in pet urine. Helps detect urinary tract infections (UTI), kidney disease, and diabetes.
services.fastingDetails: Fresh morning urine sample preferred or collected at clinic.

services.name: Renal & Kidney Function Blood Profile
services.description: Measures Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), Creatinine, Phosphorus, and SDMA to evaluate kidney filtration and detect early renal insufficiency.
services.fastingDetails: 8-12 hours fasting required before sample collection. Water is allowed.

services.name: Liver Function & Hepatic Enzyme Test
services.description: Checks ALT, AST, Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP), Total Bilirubin, and Albumin to assess liver health, bile duct status, and toxicity.
services.fastingDetails: 8-10 hours fasting required. Ensure fresh drinking water is provided.

services.name: High-Resolution Digital X-Ray (2 Views)
services.description: Orthopedic and thoracic digital radiography for diagnosing bone fractures, lung infections, arthritis, swallowed foreign bodies, and cardiac enlargement.
services.fastingDetails: No fasting needed unless mild sedation is anticipated.

services.name: Abdominal & Pelvic Ultrasound Scan
services.description: Non-invasive real-time sonography examining liver, kidneys, spleen, bladder, stomach, pancreas, and reproductive organs.
services.fastingDetails: 10-12 hours fasting required. Avoid allowing pet to urinate 1 hour prior.

services.name: Canine Parvovirus & Giardia Rapid Test
services.description: Rapid immunoassay detection of Parvovirus antigen and Giardia in puppies and adult dogs showing vomiting or diarrhea.
services.fastingDetails: Immediate sample testing. No preparation required.

services.name: Feline Leukemia (FeLV) & FIV Combo Test
services.description: Crucial screening test for outdoor and rescue cats detecting Feline Leukemia Virus antigen and Feline Immunodeficiency Virus antibodies.

services.name: Senior Pet Comprehensive Health & Organ Panel
services.description: All-inclusive blood panel + Urinalysis covering CBC, Glucose, Kidney, Liver, Electrolytes, Thyroid (T4), and cardiac risk assessment.
services.fastingDetails: 10-12 hours overnight fasting required. Fresh water is permitted.
